# Workflows as Folders {#sec-workflows-as-folders}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "orchestration needs a framework" — numbered folders of
reviewable stages are enough.

Installs: `init_workspace`, `CONTEXT.md`, `run_next()`; the review
gate between stages as the point. Working build: a three-stage
pipeline (research, outline, draft) run one reviewed stage at a time.
:::
